function.arguments: {"observation": "`customer_age` contains 108 values of exactly -1, which the documentation states means 'the customer did not supply an age'. This is a sentinel value for missing data.", "implication": "The mean age must be computed only on non-missing values. If we include -1 as a real age, it would bias the mean downward (since -1 < all real ages). Therefore, we must filter out -1 values before computing the mean."}
function.name: note_finding
